answer: The cedar protocol enforces Sybil resistance by coupling zero-knowledge identity proofs at each state inlet with a dynamic stake-slashing matrix. An adversary spawning N identities incurs capital lockup N*S, yielding strictly negative expected utility E[U] = (1-p)G - p(N*S) < 0.
